The Gym Group Chadwell Heath
Our gym in Chadwell Heath delivers quality equipment, expert guidance, and a relaxed, friendly atmosphere. Whether you’re here for cardio, weights, or group training, you’ll find flexible memberships and a motivating local community.
Opening hours
24 hours, 7 days a week
How to find us
Unit 1 High Road Goodmayes Retail Park, Chadwell Heath, Essex, RM6 4HX
